description: Ireland: PCP vs car loan vs paying cash for a car.

deposit.description: Deposit or trade-in value for the PCP and the loan, EUR (default 0)

endValue.description: Expected value of the car at the end of the PCP term, EUR (default = GMFV)

excessCentPerKm.description: Excess mileage charge, cent per km (default 10, an assumption)

expectedKm.description: Expected driving, km a year (default = allowance)

gmfv.description: GMFV / balloon payment due at the end of the PCP, EUR

kmAllowance.description: PCP mileage allowance, km a year (default 15000)

loanAprPct.description: Car loan APR % (credit union or bank)

price.description: Cash price of the car, EUR

savingsRatePct.description: Savings rate % AER before DIRT, for the cost of paying cash (default 2.5)

name: ireland_pcp_vs_car_loan
